manifest.item_selection_rule: Twelve novel self-audit sentences authored for this run: six you-one and six you-all; within each marker include directive, permission, question, object-position disclosure, report/review, and scope/applicability frames. English arms use the proposal mapping phrases “the one recipient of this message” and “every member of the addressed group”; bare you is excluded because it drops the measured cardinality claim.
manifest.method: For each tokenizer and pair, delta = tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english), using tiktoken.get_encoding(name).encode with ordinary defaults. Member value is the arithmetic mean across all 12 pairs; registered value is the least favourable member (maximum mean).
manifest.comparison_note: This is a different-item replication of the cited original, not a reproduction. The result prices only the full meaning-matched surface; it does not claim comprehension support.
